item: Basis: the Family Code provisions on the dissolution of marriage: marriage ends by divorce or death; divorce occurs at the husband's will, by mutual consent, or at the wife's request (tatliq, khul).
Divorce is established only by a judgment, preceded by several conciliation attempts by the judge within a period not exceeding three months from the filing of the claim.

The judge must draw up a record of the conciliation attempts, signed by the judge, the clerk and the parties; reconciliation during the attempts needs no new contract, after the judgment it needs a new contract.

Element to prove: a valid, existing marriage between the parties, proven by an extract of the marriage certificate from the civil-status register; if the marriage is not registered, it must first be proven by judgment (validation of the marriage) or proven in the same proceedings.
Who proves: the husband proves the marriage; he does not need to give or prove a reason for the divorce at his will, but the court may find the divorce abusive and award compensation to the wife.
Plaintiff standing: only the husband himself (or his special agent) may bring divorce at his will; the wife's route is tatliq or khul.
The public prosecution is a principal party in all cases applying the Family Code; check communication of the file to the prosecutor.
Competent section: the family section (قسم شؤون الأسرة) of the tribunal; if the court has no section, the tribunal sits in its ordinary composition.

Territorial jurisdiction: in divorce and return to the marital home, the court of the place of the marital residence (مسكن الزوجية); custody and visitation, the place where custody is exercised; maintenance, the creditor's domicile. Check whether the rule is of public order.
Defendant abroad or a foreign spouse: check the rules of international jurisdiction of Algerian courts and service abroad; delays of summons are extended for parties abroad.
Procedure: the claim is filed by petition with the mandatory elements of the CPCA; the judge sets a hearing for the conciliation attempt; the spouses must appear in person; hearings in chamber.
If a spouse fails to appear at the conciliation attempt without excuse, the judge records it and proceeds; if impediment, the judge may delegate another judge or postpone.
The judge may order provisional measures during the proceedings (custody, visitation, housing, maintenance) by urgent order.
No limitation period or forfeiture runs against the husband's right to divorce at will; no prior formal notice is required.
Mandatory conciliation in family matters replaces any pre-litigation step; mediation is excluded in family matters.
Requests: the divorce (الحكم بالطلاق); visitation right for the husband if custody goes to the mother; the judge must rule on visitation when awarding custody.

Consequences the court rules on: idda (three cycles or three months from the declaration of divorce), idda maintenance, compensation (mut'a/abusive divorce) for the wife, custody, child maintenance, housing or rent allowance for the custodian, the dowry (half the dowry if before consummation).

Custody order of priority: the mother first, then the father, then the maternal grandmother, etc., always in the child's interest; custody ends at 10 for boys (extendable to 16) and at marriageable age for girls.
The divorce judgment is not subject to appeal except in its material (financial) aspects; cassation remains open; check the period for cassation.
The divorce judgment is registered in the civil-status registers at the diligence of the public prosecutor.
Required documents: extract of the marriage certificate, family booklet, birth certificates of the children, identity papers, proof of the marital residence.
Divorce before consummation: the wife is entitled to half the dowry; no idda in that case.
Boundary: divorce by mutual consent (joint petition, separate procedure) is not divorce at the husband's will.
Boundary: tatliq at the wife's request on the listed grounds and khul are the wife's actions, not this claim.
Boundary: annulment of a void or voidable marriage (defect of a pillar, impediment) is not divorce.
Boundary: an unregistered (customary) marriage requires validation of the marriage first; combining validation and divorce must be checked.
Boundary: return to the marital home (رجوع الزوجة) and maintenance claims are separate claims, though connected.
Lis pendens: check whether a divorce, tatliq or khul action between the spouses is already pending or decided (res judicata).
Revocable divorce: during the idda the husband may take back his wife only before the judgment; after the judgment a new contract is needed.

Amendments: Ordinance 05-02 of 27 February 2005 amended the Family Code (articles on divorce, custody housing, conciliation); the CPCA of 2008 (Law 08-09) replaced the old CPC from April 2009 and organised the family section and divorce procedure; Law 22-13 amended the CPCA in 2022.
Abusive divorce: the court assesses abuse and awards compensation to the wife; the husband should expect this accessory request from the wife.
Fees: registration fees of the petition; legal aid where applicable.
